capabilities: Create saved regex find/replace quick actions
Run actions from command palette, context menus and hotkeys
Apply actions to single notes, whole folders or selected text
Undo the last executed action, including multi-file runs
extras: Export of actions and sequences to a file works on desktop only because of platform limits; the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; BRAT is only needed for beta or previous versions.
intentEvidence: Regex Quick Actions is a continuation of the idea of Regex Pipeline plugin.
motivation: The author, a Religious Studies scholar, uses the plugin in his research and in teaching a university course on information technologies in scientific research.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save and rerun regex find/replace operations on one note, a whole folder, or selected text as one-click commands.

relations.evidence: While the base of the code was borrowed from it, now every line is original.
If you want to test beta-versions of the plugin or use previous versions, you can do that with BRAT plugin

summary: Regex automation plugin that lets you create saved regex find/replace actions and sequences and run them on notes, folders or selections via commands and hotkeys.
